title: Research: restored CK helper pairs save 35,872 primitives per orientation (no new κ)
head: b1a5c533a22c2665600102d872f6a84e0664a70d
body:
## Status

Finite circuit construction (verified circuit-cost improvement). **No new κ is claimed.**

## Change

The selected #626 CK frame-zero compensation uses 124 disjoint temporary signed-unit helper shears to reduce both complete scalar programs by 35,872 real-component primitives per orientation (forward 224,938 → 189,066, backward 224,986 → 189,114; full scalar macros 21,936 → 19,036). Every source read, coefficient operation, helper preparation and restoration is charged; every dirty helper is restored before the entry adapters.

Exact arbitrary-input replay (all 716 logical columns plus a private input column, both orientations), unchanged non-scalar events, native frame/wrapper checks and 31 rejection controls pass; 11 focused tests pass with no failures or skips. Prefix bounds remain within the inherited 192-bit allowance.

Only `research/complex-ck-helper-basis/` is added. Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60` (current `main`).

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-ck-helper-basis/verify.py --out /tmp/ck-helper-replay
```

Expected final line:

```text
PASS_CK_RESTORED_HELPER_BASIS pairs=124 real_saved=35872 columns=716+1 orientations=2 controls=6+25 kappa=unchanged
```

## Scope and open obligations

This is a finite circuit construction. The paid recursive profile is unchanged, so this scalar saving alone does not supply a better recurrence exponent. Production bindings, an admitted typed compensation rewrite, and global owner/invoice/assembly receipts remain separate obligations, as do the inherited all-size, realization, hosting, residual, precision and analytic assumptions. Certificate success is not a formal verification of the multiplication theorem. Repository-wide `make verify`, full cold supplier regeneration, remote CI and Lean were not run for this package.

## Credit and overlap

Builds on the #622/#626 supplier lineage (icekylinx, DreamingOfClouds and retained predecessors). Pending #749 supplies related JP8 target-basis work; #769 shares CK coefficient preparation; #787 composes other CK coefficient-lowering and cleanup-sharing savings. This contribution instead changes CK helper columns; no pending implementation is imported and no combined saving with those PRs is asserted.
